args.name: pointer
args.help: the spot to start on, as the walk says it in `at:` - a / before each key, ~1 for a slash within one; a space within a key may be typed bare; bare starts at the top. Where it names no spot the walk starts on the longest truncation of it that stands and exits 3; an argument that is no pointer is refused, exit 2; a command x ran that failed, or a status the walk landed on that could not be read, exit 1
